rules.title: Owners may not discriminate against or harass persons because of source of income (and other protected characteristics)
rules.requirement: An owner of any housing accommodation may not discriminate against or harass any person because of source of income or the other listed protected characteristics. This includes rental applicants.
rules.quoted_span: to discriminate against or harass any person because of the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, source of income, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of that person.
rules.exemptions: Under subd. (p)(2), making a written or oral inquiry about the level or source of income is not discrimination based on source of income. The text of subd. (a) states no other exemptions.
rules.interaction: Subd. (p)(1) defines 'source of income', including government housing subsidies such as Section 8 vouchers and HUD-VASH vouchers. Subd. (p)(2) allows income inquiries.

rules.title: Owners may not inquire about protected characteristics of prospective tenants
rules.requirement: An owner of any housing accommodation may not make or cause to be made any written or oral inquiry about the listed protected characteristics of a person seeking to purchase, rent, or lease housing. The list in subd. (b) does not include source of income.
rules.quoted_span: For the owner of any housing accommodation to make or to cause to be made any written or oral inquiry concerning the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of any person
rules.exemptions: The text of subd. (b) states no exemptions.
rules.interaction: Subd. (p)(2) separately provides that inquiring about the level or source of income is not source-of-income discrimination.

rules.title: Income standards must account for aggregate income of co-residents on the same basis as married persons
rules.requirement: In renting housing, it is unlawful to use a financial or income standard that fails to account for the aggregate income of persons residing or proposing to reside together on the same basis as the aggregate income of married persons residing or proposing to reside together.
rules.quoted_span: To use a financial or income standard in the rental of housing that fails to account for the aggregate income of persons residing together or proposing to reside together on the same basis as the aggregate income
rules.exemptions: The text of subd. (n) states no exemptions.

rules.title: Where a government rent subsidy exists, income standards must be based on the tenant's portion of rent
rules.requirement: Where there is a government rent subsidy, it is unlawful to use a financial or income standard in assessing eligibility for rental housing that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant.
rules.quoted_span: Use a financial or income standard in assessing eligibility for the rental of housing that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant.
rules.exemptions: Subd. (o)(2) states that this subdivision does not limit an owner's ability to request information or documentation to verify employment, request landlord references, or verify identity.
rules.interaction: Applies in parallel with subd. (o)(1)(B) on credit history.

rules.title: Where a government rent subsidy exists, applicants must be offered alternative evidence of ability to pay in lieu of credit history
rules.requirement: Where there is a government rent subsidy, a housing provider using credit history in the application process must offer the applicant the option of providing lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of reasonable ability to pay the tenant's portion of the rent. If the applicant elects to do so, the provider must allow reasonable time to respond and reasonably consider that evidence in lieu of credit history.
rules.quoted_span: Use a person’s credit history as part of the application process for a rental accommodation without offering the applicant the option, at the applicant’s discretion, of providing lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of the applicant’s reasonable ability to pay
rules.exemptions: Subd. (o)(2) states that this subdivision does not limit an owner's ability to request information or documentation to verify employment, request landlord references, or verify identity.
rules.interaction: Applies in parallel with subd. (o)(1)(A) on income standards.
